item.title: test(ui): assert positive New Session draft behavior (#124253)
item.summary: test(ui): assert positive New Session draft behavior (#124253) * test(ui): assert positive New Session draft behavior Replace the New Session draft E2E's only assertion, a zero-count check against a CSS selector that appears nowhere in production code, with positive coverage: the draft text stays on the composer, the route and sidebar stay put, no sessions.create request fires before submit, and submitting creates exactly one session with canonical navigation. Fixes #124237 * test(ui): settle before asserting exactly-once sessions.create Reorders the exactly-once sessions.create assertion to run after the canonical navigation-settle poll (the same signal the neighboring submission test waits on), instead of right after waitForRequest resolves. The old order could pass prematurely if a late duplicate create landed after the count check but before navigation completed.
